title: Schedule opens from the top-level navigation into a sidebar + grid layout
permissions_required: Schedule: View (spec §14.1) - any role with Schedule access.
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser (window at least 960px wide).
2. Your role has the Schedule: View permission (and Work Orders: View, so the sidebar work order list loads).
steps:
1. Look at the app's main (top-level) navigation.
2. Click the Schedule item.
3. Look at the two regions of the Schedule screen.
expected:
1. Schedule is listed as a top-level navigation item alongside Work Orders, Customers, Parts, and Reports.
2. Clicking it opens the Schedule screen.
3. The left panel is the work order sidebar: a mini calendar at the top and a work order list beneath it.
4. The main area is the schedule grid showing technician rows, with a toolbar above it.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the build tested on 8/4/2026 (v3.5-4873abe), and as per epic SV-8685 and the Schedule specification version 23 (§3, §3.1, §3.2).

title: Day / Week / Month segmented control switches the grid between the three views
preconditions:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Schedule page.
3. At least one shift exists on the current week (create one first if needed, or have a colleague with Edit permission create it).
steps:
1. In the grid toolbar, click Day on the Day / Week / Month segmented control.
2. Click Week.
3. Click Month.
expected:
1. Day: the grid shows a 24-hour timeline per technician row, with shifts positioned at their times.
2. Week: the grid shows a 7-column Monday-to-Sunday layout with stacked shift chips per cell.
3. Month: the grid shows a compact calendar with per-day capacity bars and shift chips.
4. The same shifts remain visible (appropriately rendered) in all three views.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the build tested on 8/4/2026 (v3.5-4873abe), and as per epic SV-8685 and the Schedule specification version 23 (§3.2, §6).
